310 The Sentencing Council’s “Theft Offences
Definitive Guideline” (February 2016), for example, says that community orders with drug
rehabilitation, alcohol treatment or mental health treatment requirements (as applicable) may
be a proper alternative to a short or moderate custodial sentence where there is sufficient
prospect of success and, in the case of mental health difficulties, detention under a hospital
order is not warranted.
